text.p: An Albanian was killed and two Macedonian border guards were wounded in incidents along the volatile Macedonian-Albanian border on Tuesday, the Interior Ministry in Skopje said.
It said an Albanian fired from an automatic weapon at a Macedonian army patrol and seriously wounded two soldiers at Strezimir some 10 km (six miles) into Macedonian territory just after midnight.
The attacker escaped and the soldiers' lives were not in danger, the ministry said.
An Albanian was killed when a police patrol intercepted a large group of Albanians in the region of Orcuse near Gostivar before noon on Tuesday.
Some from the group fired at the patrol and the police fired back, wounding an Albanian who died on way to hospital, the ministry said.
The patrol arrested 30 Albanians from this group and another 50 who had illegally crossed the border.
Macedonian authorities fear more incursions by Albanians in search of food. Albania was rocked by riots in February and March following the collapse of pyramid investment schemes.
